literal_meaning: শরীরকে অগোছালোভাবে নাড়ানোড়ি করা বা ঝাঁকানো
figurative_meaning_en: to shake off the body (as in dusting or shivering)
example_sentences_in_bangla: মাটি থেকে উঠে সে আঁজলপাঁজল করে পরিষ্কার হল।
example_sentences_in_english: He started shaking and shivering in the cold.
After getting up from the dirt, he shook himself clean.
note: This idiom mimics the sound and action of vigorous shaking, common in rural or everyday Bengali speech.
